rounds.why: “Un cantante” is a singer; “a song” is “una canción”.
truths: “Es famoso por su música” means “He is famous for his music”.
“Sigo a muchos influencers” means “I follow lots of influencers”.

rounds.lie: “El medio ambiente” means “the middle of the room”.
rounds.why: “El medio ambiente” is a set phrase meaning “the environment”, not anything to do with a room.

rounds.lie: “Viajar al extranjero” means “to travel to a stranger”.
rounds.why: “El extranjero” here means “abroad/foreign country”, so the phrase means “to travel abroad”, not to a stranger.

rounds.lie: “Grabar un vídeo” means “to delete a video”.
rounds.why: “Grabar” means “to record”, so it means “to record a video”; “to delete” is “borrar”.
rounds.truth: “Grabar un vídeo” means “to record a video”.

rounds.why: “Tocar” is only for instruments; sports use “jugar”: “juego al fútbol”.
truths: “Toco el piano” means “I play the piano”.
“Veo series en mi móvil” means “I watch series on my phone”.

rounds.why: “La red” means “the net / network” (often the internet). “The screen” is “la pantalla”.
False friend — “actualmente” means “currently / nowadays”. “Actually” is “en realidad / de hecho”.
truths: “Conectarse a internet” means “to connect to the internet”.
